statement: He finished World 5 in five days after a viewer challenged him to do it in a week.
The new World 5 skills are some of the most overpowered hyperscale buffs the game has seen and give big idle-game dopamine.
New Divinity gods each have their own buff type.
Bear? god lets you present in lab and Divinity at the same time.
Mantas? god gives double kills that stack on Killroy Bright Side for insane kills per hour.
In the Divinity link menu you can only make one choice (unlink) per week; you can unlock one or all but unlink only once.
Sailing is slightly confusing and buggy but enjoyable with mild micromanagement.
Artifact effects are insane and help you catch up or get further ahead.
Previously rushing to World 5 before the update hurt progression but now you should rush there as quickly as possible to start the skills.
The new skills slightly remind him of idle skilling and spelunking.
Gaming is the biggest micromanagement skill and probably the craziest in numbers with huge gains.
Kitsune is a later upgrade making plants grow in about 20 to 30 minutes.
You can do the gaming skill in quick (AFK) fashion.
Get the sprinkler and shovel ASAP in gaming because they help hugely.
He loves the challenge of World 5 progression.
The developer lowered the amount of salt everything takes in World 5.
In World 4 troll armor helmet took 4000 dull salts which was absurd.
Enemies are nice and chunky like Sigma? while the portals are huge at kill count.
He is obsessed with the slab and getting all the items for plus one slab gaming.
The job shop this time is not as overkill as in World 4.
World 4 was like Warlords of Draenor; World 5 is like Legion where the developer knocked it out of the park.
World 5 is not 100 percent complete and has bugs but is a breath of fresh air for new and old players.
He says the X God might become a big multi-part worship guide.
He plans guides soon and is considering a tier list.
He will do World 5 guides eventually but wait until content is completed to avoid spoiling discovery.
He will keep mostly making IdleOn content this year while trying some other content on the side.
